attachments.origin_landmark: anterolateral arch of the cricoid cartilage (the laryngeal cartilages are not modeled as skeletal elements in this pass -- approximated via the adjacent hyoid attachment region)
attachments.insertion_landmark: inferior horn and lower lamina of the thyroid cartilage

actions: tilts the thyroid cartilage forward on the cricoid, lengthening and tensing the vocal folds

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: The ONLY intrinsic laryngeal muscle not supplied by the recurrent laryngeal nerve -- it takes the external branch of the superior laryngeal nerve instead. That single exception is why injury to the external branch during thyroidectomy lowers vocal pitch and weakens projection without producing the hoarseness of a recurrent laryngeal palsy.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
